1. Heard Sri Ashish Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Mohd. Zubair, learned counsel for opposite party no.2 and Sri Anish Kumar Upadhyay, learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant application has been files seeking quashing of the impugned order of non-bailale warrant dated 08.11.2023 and the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No. 62 of 2021 (State vs.
Mohammad Atif) arising out of Case Crime No. 421 of 2019, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC.,

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants further submits that after the dismissal of application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicants have filed another application for anticipatory bail, which is pending before this Court and no interim protection has been granted by this Court.
4. In the instant case, the charge sheet was filed on 13.01.2022 against the applicants and since then summons were issued on various dates.

Thereafter on 26.09.2023, the bailable warrant was issued and despite the bailable warrants, the applicants failed to appear, vide order dated 08.11.2023,
non-bailable warrants were issued against the applicants.

5. In the considered opinion of this Court, there is no illegality in the order dated 08.11.2023 passed by the Trial Court issuing non-bailable warrants against the applicants due to continuous deliberate absence and disobedience by the applicants herein before the Trial Court.
6. Therefore, the instant application is devoid of merit and is hereby dismissed.

Order Date :- 16.12.2023 Ashish Pd.
